quote.text: No good thing renders its possessor happy, unless his mind is reconciled to the possibility of loss; nothing, however, is lost with less discomfort than that which, when lost, cannot be missed.
quote.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the impermanence of each moment with your children; like treasures that may one day change, every phase of their growth holds unique joy if you cherish it without clinging too tightly.
    • Allow yourself to appreciate the transient nature of childhood experiences, understanding that a mind prepared for change can celebrate each fleeting moment without future regret.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, cultivate the wisdom of accepting loss and change, which enables you to guide your team with resilience and clarity even when circumstances shift unexpectedly.
    • Recognize that your successes and the loyalty of your team are precious precisely because they are not permanent; this awareness allows you to make balanced decisions free from the fear of inevitable transitions.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, understand that features and market trends are subject to change, and a mindset ready to evolve can help you innovate without being paralyzed by the fear of obsolescence.
    • Design strategies that prepare for both growth and loss; by acknowledging that every new success may eventually give way to new challenges, you foster an agile, forward-thinking mindset.
